Package io.github.brantunger.unruly.core

Class StatelessRulesEngine<O>

java.lang.Object
io.github.brantunger.unruly.core.AbstractRulesEngine<O>
io.github.brantunger.unruly.core.StatelessRulesEngine<O>
Type Parameters:
O - The output object type to instantiate when the rule's action expression is fired.
All Implemented Interfaces:
RulesEngine<O>
public class StatelessRulesEngine<O> extends AbstractRulesEngine<O>
A StatelessRulesEngine is a concrete implementation that extends the AbstractRulesEngine class. In the STATELESS implementation, the RulesEngine fires the action of a single rule. All condition fields within the ruleList are evaluated in the stateless rule engine. However, only a single action is fired. During conflict resolution the Rule with the highest priority value is found first. The action field of the rule found first will be the only action triggered. The output object is therefore generated based on only one rule. The rule with the highest priority value.

Ties: if several matching rules share the highest priority, the one that appears first in the list passed to AbstractRulesEngine.setRuleList(java.util.List) is fired.

  • Method Details

    • run

      public O run(FactStore<Object> facts)
      Run all the rules through a STATELESS rules engine and fire the action of a single rule. All condition fields within the ruleList are evaluated in the stateless rule engine. However, only a single action is fired. During conflict resolution the Rule with the highest priority value is found first. The action field of the rule found first will be the only action triggered. The output object is therefore generated based on only one rule. The rule with the highest priority value.
      Parameters:
      facts - The key/value fact store to run the rule engine against.
      Returns:
      The object that is the result of the action getting fired against the given Rule, or null if the rule list is empty or no rule matched
      Throws:
      RuleExecutionException - if evaluating a condition or executing an action fails, a condition doesn't evaluate to a boolean, or the output factory throws or returns null
      IllegalArgumentException - if a fact is named output, or has a name rules can't refer to (not a Java identifier, a reserved MVEL word such as empty or in, or a class name MVEL resolves, such as Math or a class from an imported package)
      IllegalStateException - if AbstractRulesEngine.setRuleList(List) has not been called
      NullPointerException - if facts is null
